model_annotation: The image displays two line plots comparing the training reward performance of two reinforcement learning methods—“Llama-On-Policy” and “Llama-LUFFY”—on “Easy” and “Hard” training sets, respectively. In the top plot (“Easy Training Set”), the x-axis represents “Steps” ranging from 0 to 500 with major ticks every 100 steps, and the y-axis shows “Training Rewards” from 0.0 to 0.4 with ticks every 0.2. The blue line (“Llama-On-Policy-Easy”) starts near 0.0, rises steeply to ~0.3 by step 100, then plateaus with minor fluctuations around 0.35–0.4. The red line (“Llama-LUFFY-Easy”) follows a similar trajectory, starting near 0.0, rising to ~0.3 by step 100, and stabilizing near 0.4 with more pronounced noise. In the bottom plot (“Hard Training Set”), the x-axis again spans 0 to 500 steps, and the y-axis ranges from 0.0 to 0.2 with ticks every 0.1. The blue line (“Llama-On-Policy-Hard”) begins near 0.0, rises slightly to ~0.03 by step 50, then declines to near 0.0 and remains flat. The red line (“Llama-LUFFY-Hard”) starts near 0.0, climbs steadily to ~0.1 by step 100, continues rising with fluctuations, and reaches ~0.2 by step 500, indicating sustained improvement on the harder task.
